title: Members' Cushion Days on a Re-sized Tailwise Autoship
content:
**Rewards partnership memo — cushion days**

The cushion on an existing Tailwise Autoship being re-sized to its own pet's usage (a non-prescription Autoship that has been carrying food for more than one pet of the household) follows the customer's rewards membership and shipping record. The membership is read from the customer's Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus record; the shipping record is the count of scheduled shipments of the subscription charged in the last twelve months.

| Membership in status active | Scheduled shipments of the subscription charged in the last twelve months | Cushion |
|---|---|---|
| Tailwise Plus Monthly, Tailwise Plus Annual or Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | 3 or more | 7 days |
| Pals Rewards VIP or Pals Rewards Insider | 3 or more | 11 days |
| Any other membership, no active membership, or fewer than 3 such shipments | — | not changed |

A record counts as dated in the last N months when its date is later than the same calendar day N months before the day the value is worked out, so a record dated exactly N months earlier does not count; a record dated between six and twelve months ago is one dated in the last twelve months but not in the last six months.

## Cases (hypothetical customers)

- Tailwise Plus Annual, 5 scheduled shipments in the last twelve months: 7 days.
- Pals Rewards Insider, 3 scheduled shipments: 11 days.
- Pals Rewards VIP, 2 scheduled shipments: not changed.
- Pals Rewards Member, 8 scheduled shipments: not changed.
